candidates.change_summary: Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value always differs from the input.
Delete the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so SetMinSum can be called multiple times after initialization, changing MinSum again.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so the function ignores its argument and always sets MinSum to zero.
Delete the modifier body (remove require and lock toggle) so reentrancy guard is disabled and SetMinSum can be called when locked.
Replace the condition 'if(intitalized)revert();' with 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so that SetMinSum reverts when NOT initialized instead of when already initialized.
Delete the statement 'if(intitalized)revert();' so that SetMinSum always sets MinSum, regardless of initialization state.

Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from SetMinSum, which may change reentrancy behavior but not directly the stored MinSum value—this edit does NOT guarantee observable difference in MinSum after call, so EXCLUDED. Instead, replace the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' with a no-op 'uint x = _val;' so MinSum never changes.
Insert 'MinSum = _val + 1;' after the existing assignment so that MinSum becomes _val + 1.
Remove the require(!locked_) check from SetLogFile by deleting the nonReentrant_ modifier invocation.
Remove the intitalized check so SetLogFile can be called multiple times, changing Log after initialization.
Change Log assignment to a constant zero address so the Log state variable differs after call.
Insert a revert after Log assignment so the transaction reverts but Log is not changed, differing from expected behavior.
